proposals.evidence: DEDR 3266 gives Tamil/Malayalam tī ‘fire’ and Tulu tū/sū ‘fire’. The short forms are admitted only with the fire gloss; longer burn verbs and heat derivatives are not collapsed into a fire noun. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
